_about: Tile-allocation bounds checked by tests/tools/run_goldens.py via `rasterloom-cli --stats` (BUILD-SPEC <stack> Tile engine: 64x64 sparse tiles, shared all-zero empty tile for absent entries; mutation 13 = dense grid). Every bound is derived by hand from the script: the number of 64x64 tiles that the written rect touches (tiles tx in [floor(x0/64), floor((x0+w-1)/64)] clipped to the canvas, likewise ty), never measured from the app. `total` = ceil(W/64)*ceil(H/64) per plane. Keys: 'all', 'selection', 'saved-selection' or '<what>:<node id>' with what = pixels | mask.
